Supply and installation of  CCTV camera shall be of 4 MP Network IP Bullet Camera with 1/2.9" Progressive Scan CMOS sensor and minimum resolution of 2688 multiply 1520 pixels, fitted with a 3.6 mm fixed lens and approximately 78 degree horizontal viewing angle. It shall provide Smart IR night vision up to 30 metres, support H.265/H.264 compression, DWDR, 3D DNR and Human/Person Detection, and shall have 12V DC and PoE (IEEE 802.3af) power options. The camera shall be suitable for indoor and outdoor installation with IP67 weather protection, robust metal housing and operating temperature of -40 degree C to +60 degree C, and shall be ONVIF compatible for integration with NVR/VMS. The above specifications shall be treated as minimum requirements, and equivalent or superior specifications shall also be acceptable.

32-Channel Network Video Recorder (NVR), The NVR shall support minimum 32 IP camera inputs, minimum 4 MP IP cameras or higher, H.265/H.264 video compression, minimum 160 Mbps incoming/recording bandwidth, 4K HDMI and VGA display output, and simultaneous recording, live viewing and playback. It shall have Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps) connectivity, ONVIF compatibility for multi-brand IP cameras, minimum 2 SATA HDD interfaces, USB ports, motion/event-based recording, remote monitoring through LAN/Internet/mobile application and shall be suitable for continuous 24 multiply 7 operation, complete with power supply and all necessary accessories.

8-Channel Network Video Recorder (NVR), The NVR shall support minimum 32 IP camera inputs, minimum 4 MP IP cameras or higher, H.265/H.264 video compression, minimum 160 Mbps incoming/recording bandwidth, 4K HDMI and VGA display output, and simultaneous recording, live viewing and playback. It shall have Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps) connectivity, ONVIF compatibility for multi-brand IP cameras, minimum 2 SATA HDD interfaces, USB ports, motion/event-based recording, remote monitoring through LAN/Internet/mobile application and shall be suitable for continuous 24 multiply 7 operation, complete with power supply and all necessary accessories.

4 TB Surveillance Grade Hard Disk Drive, 3.5-inch form factor, SATA 6 Gb/s interface, designed for 24 multiply 7 continuous CCTV/NVR recording, minimum 5400 RPM class, minimum 128/256 MB cache, suitable for multiple HD/4MP IP camera streams, workload rating of minimum 180 TB/year, and minimum 3-year manufacturer warranty, complete and compatible with the offered NVR.
